project_type: Migration of a native Android app (Kotlin/Jetpack Compose/Room) to a Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript web app deployed on Vercel with Neon serverless Postgres (+ pgvector for a RAG knowledge base). New web app lives under the top-level web/ directory; original Android sources under app/ are preserved.
language: TypeScript (new web app); original app is Kotlin
build_system: npm (Node 22). Next.js build via `next build`. TypeScript checks via `tsc --noEmit`. ESLint via `next lint`.
test_framework: Vitest for unit tests of the ported psychometric engine (pure functions). Configure a `test` npm script.
test_command: cd web && npm run test -- --run && npm run typecheck
verification_instructions: From web/: run `npm install`, then `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint`, `npm run test -- --run` (Vitest engine tests), and `npm run build` (Next.js production build). The build must succeed WITHOUT a live database connection: DB access must be lazy/runtime-only, never at module top-level or during build. Use env placeholders (DATABASE_URL) documented in web/.env.example. Do NOT require live Neon/OpenAI credentials for build or unit tests.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. Next.js .next/ build output and node_modules/ are git-ignored (add web/.gitignore). SQL migration/schema files under web/db/ ARE checked in and are the source of truth for the Neon schema (including pgvector).
setup_instructions: Node 22 is preinstalled. In web/: `npm install`. For local DB, set DATABASE_URL to a Neon connection string in web/.env.local (not committed). pgvector is enabled on Neon via `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS vector;` in the schema. No local Postgres needed for build/typecheck/tests.
environment_constraints: Network mode OPEN_INTERNET (npm installs allowed). No live Neon or OpenAI credentials are available in the sandbox, so verification is limited to install/typecheck/lint/unit-test/build. Runtime DB/AI behavior cannot be exercised here; design all DB and AI calls to be lazily initialized so the production build passes without secrets. Docker not required.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Keep original Android sources intact (do not delete app/). Add the web app in web/. Provide a README with Vercel + Neon deploy steps and required env vars. Never commit real secrets; use web/.env.example placeholders.
key_patterns: Domain logic to port faithfully from Kotlin: PsychometricEngine (6 RIASEC dimension scores on 0-100 = sum(score-1)/(4*answered)*100 clamped [0,100]; quality heuristics: speed trap avg<1100ms with >=10 timed items, straight-lining maxFreq/count>=0.75 with >=15 answers, mirror-pair consistency penalty 20 if diff>=3 / 10 if diff==2, mirrorConsistencyPercent=(100-penalty) clamped [40,100], reliability Alta/Moderada/Baja; career match = cosine*0.70 + euclideanProximity*0.30 scaled *100, euclideanProximity=1-(dist/2.45) with per-dim diff/100, +5% boost (*1.05 cap 99.5) when dominant dims match, final clamp [30,99]; getDominantProfileDescription 2-letter map; getDominantCode = top-N dimension letters concatenated). Seed content from SeedData.kt: 60 questions (10/dimension, mirror pairs 1<->7,11<->17,21<->27,31<->37,41<->47,51<->57), 16 careers with ideal vectors, 4 default cohorts, roles (SUPER_ADMIN/TEST_ADMIN/REPORT_REVIEWER/STUDENT). AI client is OpenAI-compatible (base_url + Bearer key), two system prompts (diagnostic report + conversational tutor). All UI strings are in Spanish and must remain Spanish.
directory_structure: Repo root: SDD_ORIENTAPP_V2.md, .env.example, app/ (Android, PRESERVED). New: web/ (Next.js app: app/ routes, lib/ domain+db+ai, db/ SQL schema, components/, data/ seed, tests/). .agents/tasks/ holds this plan.
